scripts.native:build: pnpm --filter @samuelho/coordinator-native-control build && esbuild src/plugin.ts src/native-plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent --external:@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent --outdir=dist/plugins --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);'
scripts.check: pnpm run native:build && tsx src/development.ts check
scripts.test: pnpm run native:build && tsx src/development.ts test
scripts.broker: pnpm run native:build && tsx src/main.ts broker
scripts.runner: pnpm run native:build && tsx src/main.ts runner
scripts.db:generate: prisma contract emit && prisma-effect-kysely contract --contract src/generated/prisma/contract.json --schema prisma/contract.prisma --output src/generated/database
